jose-l-piedra-cuba--linea-clasica.description: José L. Piedra carries the name of José Lamadrid Piedra, whose Asturian family settled near Santa Clara in the 1880s; Habanos dates the brand to 1880. Its filler comes only from the Remedios region of central Cuba, and every size is made totally by hand with short filler. The smoke is light in texture and woody, with cedar, a soft vanilla sweetness and nutty, creamy tones for an easy everyday break.

thirds.notes: A light, thin smoke of cedar and mild vanilla with a short finish; the small sizes can show a little early harshness.
Little changes through the middle: cedar and vanilla hold steady while the cigar burns quickly.
A warm leather note joins in and the smoke gains some weight toward the end.
